subject: Energy
title: Laser Fusion (Inertial Confinement)
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Laser Fusion (Inertial Confinement).

hook.text: Instead of magnets, laser fusion crushes fuel pellets with powerful beams—igniting fusion by compression.

buildup.text: The National Ignition Facility (NIF) uses 192 lasers—delivering 2 megajoules of energy in billionths of a second.

discovery.text: In December 2022, NIF achieved ignition—for the first time, fusion output exceeded laser energy input.

twist.text: But the lasers consumed 300 MJ of electricity to produce 2 MJ of light—overall efficiency is still far from useful.

climax.text: Laser fusion may be better suited for research and weapons simulation—magnetic fusion leads the race for power plants.

punchline.text: Ignition achieved—but a power plant is still far away.

quiz.question: What milestone did NIF achieve in December 2022?
options: Fusion output exceeded laser energy input
